theorems.statement: For every integer m>=0, P_m(Q)=sum_q q^m is an exact semiring character from finite positive-rational branch families under alternative recoalescence and serial Cartesian composition. For an explicit multigraph, W^(m)_ij=sum_{e:i->j} q_e^m and (W^(m)^n)_ij is the exact m-th power-sum of length-n path weights.

For r positive rational parallel branch weights, P_0=r and P_1,...,P_r determine the unordered weight multiset through Newton identities and the monic root polynomial. Hence if the maximum parallel multiplicity is R, W^(0),...,W^(R) determine every source-target primitive branch-weight multiset up to parallel-label permutation; higher moments satisfy the induced linear recurrence.

For fixed integer moment order m and W^(m)=[[A_m,X_m],[Y_m,B_m]], E_m(z)=z B_m+z^2 Y_m(I-z A_m)^-1 X_m satisfies (I-zW^(m))^-1[B,B]=(I-E_m(z))^-1 over Q[[z]]/Q(z). Coefficient z^n preserves the original length-n port path moment exactly. At m=1,z=1 this reduces to the recurrent Schur W_eff when the ordinary hidden block is stable.

The finite-support positive histogram semiring N[Q_{>0}^x], H=sum_q c_q[q], is a common exact carrier for count, total mass, dominant mass and every integer moment. Addition recoalesces exact weights by coefficient; multiplication convolves weights. C,W,M and P_m are typed readouts of the same carrier.

Unique factorization identifies positive rational histogram basis elements with finite Laurent monomials in prime-valuation variables. The histogram transition matrix has exact length-n path-weight histogram powers and a formal recurrent/ported transfer; specialization x_p->p^m recovers every W^(m) and E_m(z), including m=0 count and m=1 mass.

Lead(H)=(M,d), where M is the largest supported exact weight and d its coefficient, is an exact semiring quotient of the histogram carrier. For nonzero finite H, P_m(H)/M^m -> d with exact bound 0<=P_m/M^m-d<=(C-d)r^m for the largest subdominant ratio r<1. Thus ln d is the general dominant-degeneracy subleading log term; the equal-k-branch ln k law is the special case d=k.

negative_boundaries.statement: Aggregated W^(1) does not determine W^(0), W^(2), the branch histogram, or higher moments once parallel branch provenance is erased.
Ordinary W_eff=E_1(1) does not preserve original path length. Direct and internally routed paths can agree at z=1 while giving different formal z dependence.

A finite moment cutoff sufficient for primitive parallel-edge cells does not automatically remain complete after hidden-route port collapse; modules can agree at E_0,E_1 and differ at E_2 even when primitive parallel multiplicity is one.
The exact-weight histogram preserves multiplicity by exact weight but not semantic path or branch labels among equal-weight alternatives.

Formal/rational transfer identities remain algebraically valid beyond a positive convergence region, but such specializations are not interpreted as convergent recurrent positive mass sums. Signed/amplitude, complex, arbitrary irrational-exact and infinite-state extensions remain separate.
